name: openai
description: A Pulumi provider for managing resources in OpenAI.

apiToken.description: The OpenAI API key used to authenticate with the OpenAI API. Can also be set with the `OPENAI_API_KEY` environment variable.

baseUrl.description: The base URL of the OpenAI API. Defaults to `https://api.openai.com/v1`. Can also be set with the `OPENAI_BASE_URL` environment variable.

async.description: Whether compaction runs in the background. Defaults to true; set to false for blocking compaction.

timeAwareness.description: Whether the model receives periodic reminders of the current time. Defaults to false.

args.description: `stdio` transport: arguments passed to the command.

command.description: `stdio` transport: the command that starts the MCP server. Required.

cwd.description: `stdio` transport: the working directory the command runs in. Required.

envVars.description: `stdio` transport: names of environment variables the command inherits from the execution environment.

headers.description: `http` transport: non-secret headers sent with each request to the server.

serverUrl.description: `http` transport: the URL of the MCP server. Required.

maxConcurrentSubagents.description: The maximum number of subagents that run at once. Defaults to 6.

effort.description: How much reasoning effort the model spends. When unset, the model chooses its default.

summary.description: The kind of reasoning summary to produce. When unset, summaries are disabled.

format.description: The output format. Defaults to plain text.

verbosity.description: How verbose the agent's responses are. Defaults to `medium`.

schema.description: The JSON Schema the output must conform to. Required when `type` is `json_schema`.

type.description: The format type: `text` for ordinary text, or `json_schema` to constrain output to a JSON Schema.

openai:index:AgentTool.description: A tool available to an agent. `type` selects the kind of tool; each other property applies only to the tool types named in its description.

allowedDomains.description: `web_search` tools: the domains searches are restricted to.

allowedTools.description: `mcp` tools: the names of the server's tools the agent may use. When unset, all tools are allowed.

async.description: `function` tools: whether the function is called asynchronously.

connectionOrigin.description: `mcp` tools: where the connection to the server is made from.

contextSize.description: `web_search` tools: how much search context is given to the model.

credentialId.description: `mcp` tools: the ID of a stored credential used to authenticate to the server.

deferLoading.description: `function` tools: whether the function is only loaded once discovered through a `tool_search` tool.

description.description: `function` tools: a description of what the function does.

enabled.description: `programmatic_tool_calling` tools: whether programmatic tool calling is enabled. Defaults to true.

location.description: `web_search` tools: an approximate user location used to localize results.

mode.description: `web_search` tools: whether results are fetched live, served from cache, or disabled.

name.description: `function` tools: the name of the function. Required.

parameters.description: `function` tools: a JSON Schema describing the function's parameters.

requestMetadata.description: `mcp` tools: metadata sent to the server with each request.

required.description: `mcp` tools: whether the agent requires the server to be available.

serverLabel.description: `mcp` tools: a label identifying the MCP server. Required.

transport.description: `mcp` tools: how to connect to the MCP server. Required.

sessionId.description: For automations created by an agent, the session that created it.

toolCallId.description: For automations created by an agent, the tool call that created it.

openai:index:AutomationTarget.description: What an automation invocation does: it starts a new session of an agent.

agentId.description: The ID of the agent to run, such as the `id` of an `Agent` resource.

environment.description: The execution environment of each session.

input.description: The initial user messages of each session.

metadata.description: Custom key-value pairs applied to each new session.

vaultIds.description: The IDs of vaults available to each session.

openai:index:EnvironmentConfig.description: The execution environment of a session. `type` selects the kind of environment; each other property applies only to the environment types named in its description.

containerSize.description: `openai_hosted` environments: the size of the container. Defaults to `medium`.

env.description: `openai_hosted` environments: environment variables. They are secret and never refreshed from the API.

environmentId.description: `openai_hosted` environments: the ID of an existing prewarmed environment. Cannot be combined with a template or inline configuration.

environmentTemplateId.description: `openai_hosted` environments: the ID of a hosted environment template. Properties left unset inherit from the template.

files.description: `openai_hosted` environments: files placed in the workspace, up to 50.

plugins.description: `openai_hosted` environments: plugins to install, up to 32.

setupCommands.description: `openai_hosted` environments: commands run to set up the environment, up to 16. They are never refreshed from the API.

skills.description: `openai_hosted` environments: skills to install, up to 200.

type.description: The kind of environment: `none` for no execution environment, `openai_hosted` for a container hosted by OpenAI, or `self_hosted`.

workspaceDirectory.description: `self_hosted` environments: the absolute path of the workspace directory. Required.

enabled.description: Whether the environment has a desktop.

data.description: `inline` files: the content of the file, base64-encoded. Required. It is never refreshed from the API.

fileId.description: `file_id` files: the ID of the uploaded file. Required.

path.description: The absolute path of the file, which must be under `/workspace`.

type.description: Where the file's content comes from: `file_id` for an uploaded file, or `inline` for content given in `data`.

access.description: Whether network access is `enabled` (unrestricted), `disabled`, or `restricted` by the domain rules.

allowedDomains.description: The domains the environment may reach.

blockedDomains.description: The domains the environment may not reach, up to 100. Requires `restricted` access and cannot be combined with `allowedDomains`. Wildcards are not supported. They are never refreshed from the API.

name.description: The name of the plugin, as in its manifest.

source.description: The plugin as a base64-encoded ZIP archive. It is never refreshed from the API.

command.description: The command to run. The API treats it as confidential and never returns it.

cwd.description: The absolute path of the directory the command runs in. Defaults to `/workspace`.

description.description: `inline` skills: a description of the skill. Required.

name.description: `inline` skills: the name of the skill. Required.

skillId.description: `skill_reference` skills: the ID of the skill. Required.

source.description: `inline` skills: the skill as a base64-encoded ZIP archive. Required. It is never refreshed from the API.

type.description: The kind of skill: `skill_reference` for a saved skill, or `inline`.

version.description: `skill_reference` skills: the version, as a positive integer or `latest`. When unset, the skill's default version is used.

imageUrl.description: `input_image` content: the URL of the image, which may be a base64 data URL. Required.

enum.name: ToolSearch
enum.description: Lets the agent discover deferred function tools.

enum.name: ProgrammaticToolCalling
enum.description: Lets the agent call tools from code.

enum.name: Mcp
enum.description: Tools served by a Model Context Protocol server.

enum.name: Automations
enum.description: Lets the agent manage its own scheduled wakeups.

baseUrl.description: The base URL of the OpenAI API. Defaults to `https://api.openai.com/v1`. Can also be set with the `OPENAI_BASE_URL` environment variable.

openai:index:Agent.description:
A reusable OpenAI agent: a model together with its instructions, tools and settings.

This resource uses the beta Agents API.

compaction.description: Controls how the agent's context is compacted.

createdAt.description: When the agent was created, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

experimental.description: Experimental settings, which may change without notice.

instructions.description: Custom instructions, appended to the default base instructions.

metadata.description: Up to 16 custom key-value pairs. Keys can be up to 64 characters and values up to 512 characters.

model.description: The model the agent uses for inference.

multiAgent.description: Controls whether the agent can delegate work to subagents.

name.description: A human-readable name for the agent, up to 128 characters.

reasoning.description: Reasoning configuration. When unset, the model's defaults apply.

serviceTier.description: The service tier used to run the agent. Defaults to `auto`.

text.description: Configuration of the agent's text output.

tools.description: The tools available to the agent, up to 2000.

updatedAt.description: When the agent was last updated, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

openai:index:OneTimeAutomation.description:
A schedule that runs an agent once, at a given time. The invocation starts a new session.

This resource uses the beta Agents API.

createdAt.description: When the automation was created, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

metadata.description: Custom key-value pairs attached to the automation.

name.description: A display name for the automation, up to 256 characters.

runAt.description: When the automation runs, as a Unix timestamp in seconds. It must be in the future, and can only be changed until the automation has run.

status.description: The status of the automation: `active`, `paused`, or, for a one-time automation whose schedule has finished, `completed`.

target.description: What the automation does when it runs.

metadata.description: Custom key-value pairs attached to the automation.

name.description: A display name for the automation, up to 256 characters.

openai:index:PeriodicAutomation.description:
A schedule that runs an agent repeatedly, on a cron expression. Each invocation starts a new session.

This resource uses the beta Agents API.

createdAt.description: When the automation was created, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

expression.description: A five-field cron expression that sets when the automation runs.

metadata.description: Custom key-value pairs attached to the automation.

name.description: A display name for the automation, up to 256 characters.

status.description: The status of the automation: `active`, `paused`, or, for a one-time automation whose schedule has finished, `completed`.

target.description: What each invocation of the automation does.

timezone.description: The IANA timezone the cron expression is interpreted in, such as `Europe/Amsterdam`.
